title: Values of the first-level leaves
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $k\le n$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and take $p<2^{n-k}$. The value at vertex $2n+(2^{n-k}+p-1)$ is true exactly when the heap path of $x$ from offset $0$ at depth $n-k$ equals $2^{n-k}+p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$-bit inputs
